lines: A father saw a dream... and his son said: do as you are commanded.
Hazrat Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, saw in a dream that he was sacrificing his son.
He said: O my son, I see in a dream that I sacrifice you. So what do you think?
He said: O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the patient.
When they both submitted, Allah called: you have fulfilled the vision. And He ransomed him with a great sacrifice.
